tools.name: search_offerable_products
tools.description: Find products whose sellers accept price offers through forsale.xyz. Returns list prices in cents.

tools.name: get_offer_terms
tools.description: Public offer rules for one product: list price, rounds allowed, and how long offers and codes last.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Offer a price (in cents) for one unit of a product. The seller accepts, counters, or declines. An accepted offer returns a single-use discount code and a checkout link.

tools.name: respond_to_counter
tools.description: Answer the seller's counter: accept it, counter with a higher offer (amountCents required), or withdraw.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Current state of an offer, including the code and checkout link once accepted.
